title: Hosted curation upstream for Papyrus 'Import a file' (PPY-58f107 Phase B)
description: Ryan 2026-10-21: the central Cyclotron lab is the production upstream for Papyrus References 'Import a file'. Slice 1 is file import only (no hosted URL extraction). Auth option A: the lab verifies the editor's Prospectus token itself via a Prospectus lab verifier role. Lab auto-primes after accept. AWS changes (Lambda package update, PublicationTargets parameter, Prospectus deploy) each need Ryan's explicit approval.
